## Contract (verbatim requirement set, condensed)

Merges K9 UX9-3e, K5 DSRC-05 (sort and filter; chart brushing deferred),
K4 JUR-04's enhanced index filter and the K7/K8/K11 "enhanced island" ideas
as **T1 kit uses, never new islands** (C-19, C-20): `<sig-table>` on
`/sources/**`, dossier sources explorers, `/dossier/`, `/watch/`,
`/evidence/` and `/research-queue/`, with a place `<sig-typeahead>` over
≤200 KiB shards; URL state; budgets. Chart brushing explicitly deferred.
Capstone journeys O3, J1, O4 stay valid. HTML-first/no-JS parity holds.
T1 budgets: initial JS ≤20 KiB, after-action ≤40 KiB, plus the standing
document/total/data ceilings of `sig.page-budgets/1`.

## Deferrals read

`docs/tickets/DEFERRALS.md` scanned — no OPEN row names P37.61 as its

upstream (issues `#495`/`#494`, carried verbatim in LEDGER chain entries).

## Key findings at plan time

- `<sig-table>` (`web/src/elements/sig-table.ts`) and `table-model.ts`
  already implement text filter, facet chip menus, column chooser, sort
  buttons, URL state (`q`, `sort`, `dir`, facet dims, `cols`) and
  licence-aware CSV (`# sig-table export` provenance preamble). Today the
  element requires a `<table>` and upgrades thead cells only.
- `<sig-typeahead>` + `sig-src/web-shards` already cover header search,
  dossier index, scoped search, map/explore; `SHARD_MAX_BYTES = 50*1024`
  (< the 200 KiB interaction ceiling). The place typeahead requirement is
  already met by `sig-src-place` on the T2 map; no new shards are needed.
- `/sources/` already mounts ONE `<sig-table>` (licences table). The main
  `SourcesTable` + all `/sources/<view>/` variants are unmounted.
- `DossierSourcesExplorer.astro` renders `dsrc-table` (+ previous/series/
  time/placement tables) with no `<sig-table>` mount.
- `/dossier/` index renders `DossierIndexRow` `<li>` rows in three
  top-level `<ul>` groups (US states / countries / unkeyed) — a LIST
  surface, not a table.
- `/watch/` renders `ol.sig-watch-list` of `WatchList` `<li>` rows across
  index/page/kind/place/technology/vendor/history routes.
- `/evidence/` renders `ArtifactRows` `<ul>` rows on index/page/facet
  routes.
- `/research-queue/` renders `ol.sig-queue` (`QueueCard`), `ol.sig-campaigns`
  (`QueueCampaignCard`), campaign member `<ul>`s.
- `/sources/[id]/` subpages render tables: changelog, versions/latest
  extract, contributions(dossiers), entities, issues, targets, robots.
- Sort headers on `SourcesTable` already contain server sort links
  (interactive) — the kit must not nest a `<button>` inside them
  (axe nested-interactive). Plan: toolbar "Sort by" menu for interactive
  headers + list mode.
- Two mounts on one page collide on the shared `q`/`sort`/`dir`/dims URL
  params → element gains `param-prefix` so multi-mount pages namespace
  state (`src.`, `iss.`, `tgt.`, `rob.`, `cmp.`).
- Zero-JS assertions in `source-changelog.spec.ts` and
  `dossier-sources.spec.ts` pin `script` count 0 — must be relaxed to
  "only allow-listed `_kit/` modules" when mounts land (the T1 contract
  permits them; `nojs-parity` still guards content).

## Plan

1. Extend `<sig-table>` (no new element; same module entry):
   - list mode: top-level `ol`/`ul` children → per-`li` rows; columns =
     `sort`-declared `data-sort-<k>` keys + a trailing "Item" cell;
   - `param-prefix` attr namespaces all controlled params + facet dims;
   - toolbar "Sort by" menu when thead cells contain interactive content
     or in list mode; `aria-sort` untouched when no client sort is active
     (server-rendered sort links stay honest);
   - status wording "rows"/"items" by mode; column chooser stays
     table-only; CSV/filter/facets/URL work identically.
2. Shared mount component `web/src/components/KitTable.astro` —
   `<sig-table>` wrapper + colocated allow-listed script tag (ADR-224
   page-local admission pattern, `ScopedSearchForm` precedent).
3. Markup facets/sort keys on `SourceTableRow`, `DossierIndexRow`
   (+ `lib/dossier-index` facet/sort helpers exported), `WatchList`,
   `ArtifactRows`, `QueueCard`, `QueueCampaignCard`, `dsrc-table` rows,
   `/sources/[id]` subpage tables (bounded facet sets per page).
4. Mounts: `SourcesTable` (all `/sources/` table routes, `param-prefix
   src.`), `DossierSourcesExplorer` main table, `/dossier/` index (one
   mount around the three group sections), every `ol.sig-watch-list`,
   `ArtifactRows` mount, every `ol.sig-queue` + `ol.sig-campaigns`
   (`cmp.` prefix where co-mounted), `/sources/[id]` subpage tables
   (`iss.`/`tgt.`/`rob.` prefixes on the index page).
5. ADR-249 records the owned decision (list-mode extension, param
   prefix, toolbar sort menu) + ADR_TRIGGERS/BL-087/BACKLOG regen.
6. Tests: list-mode e2e per surface, sort-menu path, URL-state restore,
   CSV, multi-mount param namespacing, K0 failure leg, zero-JS spec
   relaxations, unit tests for new helpers. Harness fixture extended for
   list mode.

## Deviations

- Chart brushing: NOT implemented (explicitly deferred by C-20/ticket).
- New islands: none — the rollout uses the existing allow-listed
  `_kit/sig-table.js` entry only.
- `data-facet-label-<dim>`: a positional per-row chip-label map added to
  the element + `table-model` (queue place facets keyed by slug carry a
  human label; values stay the URL/filter keys). Recorded in ADR-249 —
  required because raw slugs contain ungrouped GEOID runs the K14 NEW-8
  chrome sweep reads as public text.
- `acceptance-parity.spec.ts`: the SIG-DSRC-D09 row regex relaxed
  `<tr data-source-id="X">` → `…"[^>]*>` — the contract (id-first row
  identity + verbatim cell parity) is unchanged; the mount's
  `data-facet-*` attrs are enhancement metadata on the same row.
- `page-budgets.json` `measured_gaps` `/dossier/`: re-recorded under the
  same deferral (D-P36.64-1) — honest +~6.8 KB wire for the required
  mount (module + per-row restated metadata): 182,972 B gzip /
  178,129 B brotli, bound 177,000 → 190,000, ratified 174,080 untouched.
  Same re-record pattern as the P37.45 head.
- `page-budgets.json` `measured_gaps` `/explore/` interactionLatencyMs
  (fixtures): re-recorded under the same deferral (D-P35.51-3) —
  consecutive full-suite legs measured 508–576 ms over the 500 bound
  (idle focused leg ≈259 ms; suite-load timing is the honest measure).
  Bound 500 → 600, ratified 200 untouched. Unrelated surface — the
  rollout ships nothing to `/explore/`; recorded, not smoothed.
- `epistemic.css`: explicit `[hidden] { display:none }` so filtered
  flex rows (`.sig-dossier-index__item` etc.) honour the element's
  DOM-preserving hide (the class's `display:flex` beat the UA rule).
- `page-budgets.json` `measured_gaps` `/sources/` + `/sources/runs/`
  `lcpMs` (CI re-record, run 43752572578 on the records head): the
  three-run lab measures read 1658.68–1661.80 ms on `/sources/` (the
  required mount's honest bytes on the heaviest T1 document) and
  1508.05–1518.31 ms on `/sources/runs/` — the same ~1.5 s fleet-wide
  first-paint floor D-P36.48-1 owns. `/sources/` re-recorded at 1,660 /
  bound 1,750; `/sources/runs/` recorded for the first time at 1,518 /
  bound 1,600, same deferral; ratified 1,500 untouched on both (warn
  twin), stale-row fails when the measure drops under the ratified
  ceiling. `gen-lhci.mjs` gained the `/sources/runs/` surface block +
  T1 exclusion; the generated rc files regenerated, never hand-edited.
- `tests/visual/baselines.json` + 59 snapshots: adopted under P37.61 via
  `scripts/visual-adopt-baselines.mjs` (SIG-UI-152 sanctioned path) from
  run 43768279012's linux actuals — the authored diff is the mount's
  toolbar chrome (filter input, facet disclosures, CSV action, sort
  control) above the rollout tables/lists; diffs of 2–5% on the rollout
  routes, no content change.
